chunks: Sa'd also narrated it from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan or someone else, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, similarly to that.

The first point regarding it is that it is a mursal report with a broken sanad/isnad, because Ja'far ibn Bashir said in the first narration, ‘from the one who narrated it,’ and in the second narration he said, ‘from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan or someone else,’ so he reported it while being doubtful. That which proceeds in this manner is not obligatory to act upon. Even if the report were sound as it stands, it would be interpreted as applying to one who made himself junub deliberately, because whoever is like that, his obligation is ghusl in every state; if he is unable, he performs tayammum and offers salat, then repeats when he becomes able to use it. And that which indicates that one whose description is such, his obligation is ghusl in every state, is...

key_terms.أَجْنَبَ نَفْسَهُ مُخْتَارًا: He caused himself to enter the state of janabah deliberately.
key_terms.الْعَمَلُ بِهِ: Acting upon the report as legal proof.
key_terms.الْغُسْلُ: The ritual bath required after janabah.
key_terms.تَيَمَّمَ: He performed tayammum as a substitute purification.
key_terms.خَبَرٌ مُرْسَلٌ: A report lacking a fully connected chain of transmission.
key_terms.شَاكٌّ: Being uncertain or doubtful in the transmission.
key_terms.مُنْقَطِعُ الْإِسْنَادِ: Having a broken sanad/isnad with discontinuity between narrators.

ai.seo_question: Does a junub person who performs tayammum and prays have to repeat the salat, and how does sanad/isnad weakness affect the ruling?
ai.summary: This passage critiques a hadith on the basis of sanad/isnad weakness, describing it as mursal and disconnected because of uncertainty in the transmission. It then explains the legal ruling that if a person became junub deliberately, the original obligation of ghusl remains, and if forced to resort to tayammum and salat, he must repeat the prayer upon regaining ability to use water.
